headline: Sanad targets homegrown UAE talent for 1,000-plus GTF technician roles
summary: Sanad's new Al Ain GTF engine centre will need more than 1,000 technicians, aiming to develop homegrown UAE aerospace talent and expand its global maintenance, repair and overhaul operations.
why: Sanad is an aircraft maintenance provider, and engine MRO capacity is a key part of the aerospace supply chain for airlines.
